chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one person, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abd Allah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about the funerals of men and women when they are gathered together. He said: The men are placed first, according to the Book of 'Ali عليه السلام.

key_terms.اجْتَمَعَتْ: were gathered together in one place
key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: the men whose funerals are present
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: the women whose funerals are present
key_terms.جَنَائِزِ: funeral biers or funerals being arranged for the prayer
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: the written source attributed to Imam 'Ali عليه السلام used as legal authority
key_terms.يُقَدَّمُ: is put forward or placed first in order

ai.seo_question: When the funerals of men and women are gathered together, which should be placed first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the arrangement of funeral biers when the جنازات of men and women are gathered together. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that the men are placed first, and attributes this ruling to the Book of 'Ali عليه السلام, indicating an established transmitted practice.
